description: Deterministic family taxonomy and relationship-class thresholds consumed by tools/strategy_farm/lineage_map.py. Coarse families reuse the whitespace-audit slug derivation (research_universe_whitespace.md; observe_projector.classify_family). Named families scope the §9 heavily-represented clusters. Thresholds are the audit-proposed lineage cut-offs; changing any threshold is a GELB decision (report the raw evidence, never re-cut silently).

coarse_families._note: Ordered first-match slug classifier (a slug is lower-cased; the first family whose keyword substring appears wins). Ties broken by list order, exactly as observe_projector._FAMILY_KEYWORDS. An empty slug -> 'unclassified'; no match -> 'other'.

named_families._note: Non-exclusive tags for the §9 heavily-represented clusters. Membership is by slug substring (lower-cased) OR by traded symbol base name (for symbol-scoped clusters). An EA can be tagged by several named families (e.g. a Balke XAU range breakout is balke + breakout + xau_systems). Report order below is the §9 order.

materially_different_scope._note: Mechanism-scoped families for which a MEASURED same-symbol pair that is not a clone/same-edge is emitted as a 'materially_different' edge (a genuine 'same mechanism label, different edge' finding). Symbol-scoped families (xau_systems) are excluded: two distinct gold strategies trading XAU are not a same-label finding, so only their positive relationships (clones / same-edge convergence) are emitted, not the materially-different default.

thresholds._rationale: Audit-proposed cut-offs (lineage_tooling.md). rule_sim = normalized-strategy-region token similarity in [0,1]; jaccard = entry-day trade-overlap in [0,1] on the same symbol+overlapping window; rho = Pearson correlation of daily net-PnL vectors. Clone bars are deliberately strict so a clone claim is defensible; same-edge bars are looser to catch convergent-death families without over-merging.

relationship_classes._note: Evaluated top-down; first match wins. Pairwise §9 classes. Basis records which input decided the class.

rules.exact_clone: rule_signature equal (byte-normalized strategy region) OR a runtime IDENTICAL equivalence proof.
rules.close_implementation_clone: rule_signature differs but rule_sim >= rule_sim_close_clone AND (no stream evidence, else jaccard >= jaccard_close_clone AND rho >= rho_close_clone). Same mechanism re-typed.
rules.parameter_variant: same rule_signature (or rule_sim >= rule_sim_param_variant) with a differing parameter set (0 < param_distance <= param_variant_max_distance) and, where streams exist, jaccard >= jaccard_param_variant. Retuned knobs on identical code.
rules.same_edge_different_implementation: rule_sim < rule_sim_close_clone but streams give jaccard >= jaccard_same_edge AND rho >= rho_same_edge on the same symbol/window. Different code, correlated trades -> same underlying edge.
rules.child_challenger: declared parent_ea_id / variant_of link that is not already exact/parameter_variant (a materially reworked declared descendant).
rules.superseded: a declared descendant or parameter_variant whose parent carries a terminal RETIRE / worse terminal verdict, or an explicit OWNER supersede receipt.
rules.materially_different: none of the above (jaccard < jaccard_same_edge and rho < rho_same_edge, no declared link, rule_sim below close-clone). Genuinely distinct.

master_directive_classes_56._note: Per-rebuild §56 classification (reported in the Markdown census, not an edge relation). Mapped from the pairwise §9 evidence + census findings.

seed_edges._note: Hand-seeded edges for relationships that are established by a dated research verdict but where one endpoint has no built EA (so no signature/stream can confirm them). basis=HAND_SEEDED. These are documentation of an existing verdict, never a new gate decision.

edges.note: Gold Reaper (Wim Schrynemakers / Profalgo) classified as the same dead XAU session-breakout edge as Balke XAU (QM5_13213 XAUUSD, Q02 RETIRE). Seed card QM5_31008 status REJECTED, never built. Source: docs/research/GOLD_REAPER_BREAKOUT_MINING_2026-07-23.md.

seed_nodes._note: Minimal nodes for seed-only EAs referenced by seed_edges that have no framework/EAs build (no .mq5, no stream). Family is declared, mechanism_signature is null (EVIDENCE_MISSING).

QM5_31008.note: seed card only (strategy-seeds/cards/QM5_31008_gold-reaper-order-block-mitigation.md), status REJECTED, never mechanised into the pipeline.
